scientific_statement: The final reaction-difficulty model is a condition-agnostic ordinal model trained exclusively on human expert labels using three predictors: feasibility difficulty (D_F), precedent difficulty (D_P), and normalized delta synthetic complexity (D_SC). The locked test set was not used for model fitting, feature selection, threshold selection, uncertainty calibration, or hyperparameter selection. Reaction difficulty is a relative expert-aligned score and must not be interpreted as experimental success probability or reaction yield.
